_note: Firefox Add-ons (addons.mozilla.org). Tên (AMO ≤ 50 ký tự → 'names' dưới đây); tóm tắt (≤ 250)/mô tả: dùng chung store/chrome/listing.json (15 ngôn ngữ) – không chép lại. Gói: bash scripts/build-firefox.sh → store/lexkite-firefox.zip. Hướng dẫn: docs/EDGE-SUBMIT.md §Firefox. Chủ tự tạo tài khoản + bấm gửi.
notesToReviewer: No account or login is needed. Source: the submitted package is the readable, unminified extension (no bundler, no remote code). Test: open any English page, double-click a word to see the lookup card (IPA, audio, meanings); select a sentence and press the translate icon. Network use: lookups go to the public dictionary/translation endpoints declared in the privacy policy; saved words stay in extension storage. Permissions: storage, alarms, notifications (study reminders, can be turned off), contextMenus, scripting, search (new-tab search box uses the default search engine) and http/https host access to show the lookup card on pages - same as the Chrome build (store/chrome/permissions.lock.json).
